newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian refugee boat runs aground off Italy.
newsitem.headline: Albanian refugee boat runs aground off Italy.

text.p: An Albanian navy ship carrying scores of refugees fleeing the lawless Balkan country ran aground in shallows off the southern Italian port of Brindisi late on Saturday night, Italian coastguards said.
A Reuter correspondent on a coastguard vessel at the scene said the Albanian ship's deck was crowded with people, some waving white flags as they waited to be rescued.

There was no sign of any of the refugees in the water, despite reports that some had jumped in to the shallows to swim to the nearby land, but an Italian helicopter was hovering over the ship with a searchlight scanning the sea.
A coastguard officer said some on the ship, which had mechanical failure and ran aground several hundred metres off the shore as it was being led into port, were injured.
All the refugees were being ferried to nearby vessels.
The officer said that there could be as many as 300 Albanians on board. Similar boats have arrived in Italy with around 200 people crammed into them.
Hundreds of Albanians have been streaming across the Adriatic sea in a ramshackle fleet of decrepit boats since violence broke out in the country this month.
Italy has said the refugees will be given political asylum but will be repatriated once the anarchy subsided.
